caveats: Exposed fixed development corpus; no independent strength, arena or win-rate inference.
Turns, overlapping starts and opponent replies are correlated; their counts are not independent games.
Primary promises count only original W forecasts against noHit arms under the matching initial retained opponent reply.
Passive comparisons test native-model promises under a different opponent and remain secondary.
Rolling forecasts use FRESH_V09_OPPONENT_CONTEXT, unlike the fixed initial opponent that advances episodes.
Earned-score deltas describe at most eight resolved turns, stopping at terminal states; no million-unit proxy bonuses.
File consistency is independently checked here; exact native/core parity and legality are runtime assertions in the pinned harness, not new evaluations.
A minus W is final earned score DIFFERENCE, not match wins or million-unit utility.
Only same original native reply and the noHit arm support primary promise execution counts.
Pure-WAIT88 promise observations derive from56 trajectories against multiple initial native forecasts.
No terminal win within eight turns does not establish an eventual loss.
